# Data Quality Engineering

Run after a successful Bronze and Silver build. The gate in `data_pipelines/quality/` checks table presence, raw/Silver row counts, deduplication, required fields, domains, partitions, date parsing and foreign keys; it also measures product-owner mismatches and pre-opening transactions. Add a focused failing fixture before changing a check. Query Bronze for raw defects and Silver for typed readiness. Keep warnings visible, and never turn missing or invalid values into a reassuring zero. Record the source snapshot and explain changes in counts before publishing an analysis.
